studies.Title: A case-control study of risk factor for renal cell cancer in northern Italy.
studies.Reference: A case-control study of risk factor for renal cell cancer in northern Italy.

extraction_supporting_text.sample_size: A hospital-based case-control study of renal cell cancer was conducted in northern Italy between 1986 and 1989, with 240 cases of renal cell cancer (150 males and 90 females), and 665 controls (445 males and 220 females) chosen on the basis of age, sex, and area of residence.
extraction_supporting_text.cases: A hospital-based case-control study of renal cell cancer was conducted in northern Italy between 1986 and 1989, with 240 cases of renal cell cancer (150 males and 90 females), and 665 controls (445 males and 220 females) chosen on the basis of age, sex, and area of residence.

extraction_supporting_text.continent: A hospital-based case-control study of renal cell cancer was conducted in northern Italy between 1986 and 1989
extraction_supporting_text.exposure_measurement: No associations were found between renal cell cancer and: body mass index (BMI); number of cigarettes smoked; age at starting to smoke; years of smoking; consumption of wine, beer, spirits, coffee, decaffeinated coffee; tea; intake of animal protein, fruits, and vegetables
